infrastructureRisks.details: Project located on the 700-meter stretch between DESU Colony and Janakpuri D-Block. Mired in bureaucratic paralysis for over a decade, stuck at the consultancy stage due to technical feasibility and lack of bidder interest. PWD project.

demandDrivers.details: Density of high-performance luxury vehicles in Janakpuri (Blocks C, D) justifies inventory costs for XP100 (100 Octane petrol).
Increasing number of turbocharged engines in mid-range cars require XP95 (95 Octane petrol).

demandDrivers.driver: Commercial vehicles and new-generation diesel luxury vehicles
demandDrivers.details: Demand for additive-enhanced diesel offering better combustion and lower noise.
High throughput of auto-rickshaws and taxis due to Delhi's mandatory CNG policy.
Fuel at Call program for door-to-door delivery of diesel for backup generators in hospitals, malls, and apartment complexes.

accessAnalysis: Double-Edged Sword scenario: Absolute visibility due to slow-moving traffic, but difficult conversion as commuters fear losing their place in traffic to enter the station. Severe congestion on Pankha Road limits throughput. Maintenance work on Sagarpur flyover and Janak Setu (e.g., repair of expansion joints) frequently reduces traffic to a single lane, causing long backups.
